es.title: Muere Xosé Luís Méndez Ferrín, el escritor que marcó los últimos 70 años de la literatura gallega con su imaginación materialista
es.description: Autor de poemas memorables y narraciones antológicas, expresidente de la Real Academia Galega, fue además un feroz militante antifranquista, comunista e independentista hasta el final, encarcelado por la dictadura y también en democracia Hemeroteca - Sale a la luz una novela inédita que mandó a su autor a las prisiones franquistas En sus páginas convivían -sin solución de continuidad- el proletariado organizado y la Materia de Bretaña, una nación en armas contra el opresor y los matices del otoño en Terra de Bea, la experiencia visionaria de observar las Illas Cíes y la solidaridad con los condenados de la tierra, Bertolt Brecht y Álvaro Cunqueiro, las célebres pólvora y magnolias, al fin y al cabo. La imaginación de Xosé Luís Méndez Ferrín era materialista y su materialismo era fantástico. Fue, con apenas discusión, el escritor que, desde la publicación de Percival e outras historias (1957), marcó los últimos 70 años de la literatura gallega. Autor de poemas inconmensurables y de narraciones antológicas, expresidente de la Real Academia Galega, feroz militante antifranquista, comunista e independentista hasta el final, erudito pero conocedor profundo de la cultura popular, murió este 18 de noviembre en Vigo, donde residía desde hace décadas. Méndez Ferrín, O Ferro le llamaba los amigos, había nacido en Ourense en 1938, plena Guerra Civil, en una familia de la pequeña burguesía democrática. El galleguismo republicano, que le gustaba reivindicar en la figura de Otero Pedrayo -conservador pero represaliado y leal a la memoria de Castelao-, nunca le fue ajeno. Ya en Santiago de Compostela, a donde llegó en la primera mitad de los años 50 para estudiar Filosofía y Letras, entró en contacto con Ramón Piñeiro y el culturalismo que recién se organizaba alrededor de la editorial Galaxia. Allí publicó su primer libro de relatos, el mencionado Percival, con solo 19 años. El mundo que allí desplegaba, una suerte de ampliación violenta de mitos artúricos y de la literatura grecolatina, funcionó como núcleo de toda su escritura -en prosa- posterior. A las prisiones franquistas por una novela Pero, en una trayectoria paralela a la de su gran amigo, y compañero de partido en Anova, Xosé Manuel Beiras, la estrategia culturalista del galleguismo de posguerra no tardó en resultarle asfixiante. Su ruptura, estruendosa, fue a un tiempo estética y política. Ferrín trabajaba para incorporar la literatura gallega a la contemporaneidad y el nacionalismo a la izquierda revolucionaria que, en los años 60, agitaba el mundo. Había conocido el marxismo entre Madrid, en donde se licenció en filología románica en 1960 y contribuyó a la consitución del seminal Grupo Brais Pinto, y Oxford, donde había estudiado cultura inglesa durante un curso y donde, recordaba a menudo, enseñaba su admirado Tolkien. Y en 1964 es uno de los fundadores de la Unión do Povo Galego, el partido comunista y nacionalista entonces clandestino cuya evolución aún hoy explica parte fundamental del soberanismo gallego. Su militancia no fue lateral: uno de sus más destacados dirigentes, acabó en la temida cárcel de El Dueso (Cantabria) después de que, en el estado de excepción de 1969, la policía franquista irrumpiese en su domicilio y requisase una novela, todavía inédita, dedicada a la guerrilla antifranquista en Galicia. O corvo, a figueira e a fouce de ouro se titulaba y, tras años perdida, la localizó el investigador Fernando Ramallo entre la documentación del Tribunal de Orden Público que lo había juzgado. “El mío es el único caso de un escritor que fue a la cárcel franquista por escribir una novela, ¡ni siquiera por publicarla!”, relataba Méndez Ferrín a elDiario.es en 2020. Los dos años que pasó en las prisiones de la dictadura no los desaprovechó: redactó su magnífica novela Antón e os iñocentes (1976), algunos de los poemas que publicaría bajo el heterónimo de Heriberto Bens, y se familiarizó con la jerga de los gitanos, uno de sus múltiples intereses filológicos. Y justo a la salida publicó una de sus piezas más recordadas, polémicas y contundentes, Retorno a Tagen Ata. Esta nouvelle es su ajuste de cuentas con el piñeirismo y lo que juzgaba como posición liquidacionista del galleguismo del interior tras la Guerra Civil. Escrita a modo de parábola, su protagonista, Rotbaf Luden, una joven guerrilera de 23 años, representa la ruptura política y generacional dentro de la resistencia a la dictadura. De fondo, los procesos de liberación nacional de Cuba, Argelia, Irlanda o Euskal Herria. Fanon contra Terra Ancha. La narrativa de Ferrín continuó avanzando y, al mismo tiempo, impulsando las letras gallegas a atravesar nuevas fronteras. El desencanto y la frustración política, que nunca renuncia, atraviesa los cuentos de Crónica de nós (1980), formidable colección en que Cortázar sirve para atravesar el proceloso mar de algunas derrotas. Pero la crítica suele coincidir en que es tal vez Arraianos (1992) la cumbre de su producción en el género: cierto realismo mágico, oscuro y telúrico en el que los fantasmas del 36 y las leyendas de la frontera galaico portuguesa pueblan un territorio a veces inhóspito y siempre preñado de sangre y barro. Solo cinco años antes, la novela Bretaña, Esmeraldina (1987), más bien incomprendida en su día, supuso en realidad un golpe incomparable en la literatura gallega, relato histórico, político -de nuevo la lucha anticolonial- y fantasioso que se movía simultáneamente hacia el pasado y hacia el futuro. La alargadísima sombra de su poesía Y, sin embargo, fue la poesía el ámbito en el que la sombra de Ferrín resulta más alargada. Si su juvenil Voce na néboa (1957) -sin reeditar hasta 2003- anunciaba algunos de los caminos que se abrían ante el poeta, sus poemas como Heriberto Bens -Antoloxía Popular (1972)- dejaban ya las cosas claras: una altísima exigencia formal indisociable del radicalismo político. “Triste está a patria de Peire Cardenal. / Pedra é o ollo do bon labrador. / Frío é o alento do escravo da terra. / A morte pousa nas cortes desertas”, escribía en su totémico Sirventés pola destrución de Occitania (1975) -la caja de herramientas de Ezra Pound pero con objetivos emancipadores-, “Compañeiriños curvados, / pequenos homes vencidos sobre os que medra o xasmín / coma un estigma!”. Pero fue un año después de la muerte del dictador que Ferrín volvió a sacudir la literatura gallega. La onda expansiva de Con pólvora e magnolias aún no se ha detenido. Lo que inicialmente se leyó como oposición a los estertores del social realismo era sobre todo un gesto político, alimentado por las tesis sobre escritura de los materialistas históricos más lúcidos: combinar Marx y Rimbaud, ser absolutamente modernos. Allen Gisberg y Paul Eluard en Santiago de Compostela, Janis Joplin y Ulrike Meinhoff, Cunqueiro, el románico de Vilar de Donas, Safo y Manuel María, Mao Tse-Tung y Kerouac, la decadencia, el aterrador paso del tiempo y los horizontes revolucionarios, los significados e ideas desplegados por uno de los principales libros de la poesía gallega de todos los tiempos no se agotan. “Atópome coa testa contra o muro. / Convócome a min mesmo como quen olla un pozo. / Volta un neno perdido / por rúas de fume, por pasigos brancos, / tráxico, con tatuaxes nas meixelas / e lumes pequenos en cada dedo”, dice Diante de Compostela doutros días. Ferrín nunca redujo la tensión. En Do fin dun canto (1982) incluyó poemas vertebrales para entender no solo su obra en verso sino quizás su actitud ante la existencia -Tito Lucrecio Caro: “Besta irmá, certamente / cousa ningunha abrolla dende a nada, / nada retrona á nada ou se aniquila, / todo prende de todo e todo é sempre”. Y en Estirpe (1994) alcanzó otro pico de su escritura, un libro dedicado a tres colegas con los que de alguna manera compartía posición ante el poema: Seamus Heaney, Derek Walcott y Antonio Gamoneda. Contra Maquieiro (2005), una imprecación salmódica contra el lucro como ética y con esa nostalgia irresistible que a menudo respiraba en sus versos, fue su despedida de la literatura. No del periodismo. Su artículos en Faro de Vigo, ya antes en el histórico semanario nacionalista A Nosa Terra bajo otro heterónimo, Dosinda Areses, se cuentan por centenares. El último salió hace un mes. Trataba sobre Xosé Manuel Beiras: “El caso es que fuimos jóvenes al mismo tiempo […] Beiras recibía una Galicia incompleta e iba dándole nombre a sus problemas y contribuyendo a sus soluciones colectivas”.

it.title: Van Gogh da record, "Castagni in fiore" venduto per 190,4 milioni
it.description: New York, 19 nov. (askanews) - "Castagni in fiore" (Chataigniers en fleurs) di Vincent van Gogh, dipinto dall'artista poco prima della sua morte nel 1890, nell'ultimo periodo creativo ad Auvers-sur-Oise, è stato venduto per 190,4 milioni di dollari in un'asta organizzata da Sotheby's a New York, stabilendo un nuovo record di vendita per un'opera dell'artista olandese. Il primato era di "Frutteto con cipressi", battuto per 117,2 milioni ottenuti nel 2022. È anche al secondo posto tra le opere più costose mai vendute nella storia di Sotheby's, preceduto soltanto dal "Ritratto di Elisabeth Lederer" di Gustav Klimt, battuto a novembre del 2025 per 236,4 milioni. Una vendita preceduta da problemi. La casa d'aste ha annunciato all'ultimo l'accordo raggiunto con gli eredi dell'ex proprietario dell'opera, l'editore ebreo Samuel Fischer, che si opponevano alla sua messa in vendita, sostenendo che la famiglia di quest'ultimo fosse stata costretta a cederlo in anni difficili sotto la pressione della persecuzione nazista.

mx.title: FBI: intentos de acceso en 2,250+ tenants de Microsoft 365
mx.description: ✨ Resumen (TL;DR): El FBI precisó que la alerta cuenta intentos de inicio de sesión, no accesos confirmados en todos los entornos. Los intentos llegaron a más de 2,250 entornos de Microsoft 365. Microsoft detectó actividad posterior al acceso en varios entornos y recomienda revisar los registros de cada organización. El FBI precisó que el ataque de octubre contra ConnectWise Cloud Backup derivó en intentos de inicio de sesión en más de 2,250 entornos de Microsoft 365. La cifra señala dónde hubo intentos, no cuántos entornos sufrieron una intrusión confirmada, y corrige la versión anterior de la alerta. El boletín conserva la fecha del 13 de noviembre de 2026 y el identificador FLASH-20261113-001. La versión vigente al 18 de noviembre de 2026 mantiene la cifra por encima de 2,250, pero aclara que se refiere a entornos donde se intentó iniciar sesión. La versión anterior afirmaba que el incidente había permitido acceder a esos entornos. El documento no señala cuándo cambió la frase; la redacción actual coincide con el recuento que Microsoft publicó tras investigar el ataque. Te podría interesar: FAA, Microsoft y Chase: fallas con causas distintas Qué mide el recuento del FBI Un tenant de Microsoft 365 es un entorno que reúne las cuentas, aplicaciones y configuraciones que administra una organización. Un mismo entorno puede registrar varios intentos, por lo que el total agrupa los tenants alcanzados por esos intentos, no las intrusiones confirmadas. Para establecer cuántos entornos sufrieron una intrusión hace falta evidencia de accesos efectivos en cada uno. Qué observó Microsoft en los clientes de respaldo El 21 de octubre, Microsoft informó que el grupo Storm-0940 utilizó ARTEX, una herramienta de pruebas de seguridad que coordina agentes de inteligencia artificial, para ampliar la actividad contra clientes del servicio de respaldo. La investigación de Microsoft registró actividad posterior al acceso en varios entornos. Entre los hallazgos hubo cambios en las credenciales de aplicaciones e intentos de ampliar los permisos de esas aplicaciones. Microsoft presentó esos hallazgos por separado del total de entornos con intentos. En varios casos, los atacantes obtuvieron acceso privilegiado a infraestructura en la nube en menos de tres horas. Ese plazo describe la rapidez de los incidentes observados, no el alcance de los intentos vinculados con ConnectWise. ConnectWise reanudó los respaldos el 28 de octubre ConnectWise informó que los respaldos y las restauraciones de Microsoft 365 volvieron a estar disponibles desde el 28 de octubre para los entornos que reautorizaron la conexión. La empresa indicó que los archivos de respaldo existentes permanecieron cifrados y aislados, sin indicios de que hubieran sido comprometidos. También advirtió de un intervalo sin copias nuevas entre el último respaldo previo a la suspensión y el primero completado tras reanudar el servicio. ConnectWise señaló que las medidas aplicadas en su servicio dejan intacta la configuración de los entornos de sus clientes. Recuperar los respaldos determina desde qué momento pueden restaurarse los datos; saber si alguien accedió a Microsoft 365 o cambió permisos requiere revisar los registros de cada organización. Qué deben revisar los administradores Microsoft recomienda revisar los inicios de sesión de aplicaciones, buscar cambios inesperados en credenciales o permisos y conservar los registros relevantes. Esa evidencia permite determinar si los intentos dejaron actividad en un tenant concreto, algo que la cifra de más de 2,250 por sí sola no establece. Fuentes: 1, 2, 3, 4 The post FBI: intentos de acceso en 2,250+ tenants de Microsoft 365 appeared first on Qore.

sg.title: Youdao, Inc. to Hold Annual General Meeting on December 17, 2026
sg.description: BEIJING, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Youdao, Inc. ("Youdao" or the "Company") (NYSE: DAO), an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising, today announced that it will hold its annual general meeting of shareholders (the "AGM") at its offices at Building No.7, West Zone, Zhongguancun Software Park (Phase II), No.10 Xibeiwang East Road, Haidian District, Beijing, People's Republic of China on December 17, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (Beijing Time). No proposal will be submitted for shareholder approval at the AGM. Instead, the AGM will serve as an open forum for shareholders and beneficial owners of the Company's American Depositary Shares ("ADSs") to discuss Company affairs with management. The Board of Directors of the Company has fixed the close of business on December 1, 2026 (Eastern Standard Time) as the record date (the "Record Date") for determining the shareholders entitled to receive notice of, and to attend, the AGM or any adjournment or postponement thereof. Holders of record of the Company's Class A ordinary shares and Class B ordinary shares at the close of business on the Record Date are entitled to attend the AGM and any adjournment or postponement thereof in person. Beneficial owners of the Company's ADSs are also welcome to attend the AGM in person. Shareholders and ADS holders may access the Company's annual report on the Company's investor relations website at http://ir.youdao.com as well as the SEC's website at http://www.sec.gov. The Company will provide a hard copy of its annual report containing the audited consolidated financial statements, free of charge, to its shareholders and ADS holders upon request. Requests should be directed to the Company by emailing Investor Relations at IR@rd.netease.com. About Youdao, Inc. Youdao, Inc. (NYSE: DAO) is strategically positioned as an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising. Youdao now mainly offers learning services, online marketing services and smart devices – all powered by advanced technologies. Youdao was founded in 2006 as part of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTES; HKEX: 9999), a leading internet technology company in China. For more information, please visit: http://ir.youdao.com. sg.title: Youdao Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
sg.description: HANGZHOU, China, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Youdao, Inc. ("Youdao" or the "Company") (NYSE: DAO), an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Total net revenues were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million), representing a 12.3% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from learning services were RMB609.4 million (US$90.9 million), representing a 5.2% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from smart devices were RMB145.2 million (US$21.7 million), representing a 40.9% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB674.3 million (US$100.6 million), representing an 8.8% decrease from the same period in 2025. Gross margin was 43.6%, compared with 42.2% for the same period in 2025. Income from operations was RMB33.7 million (US$5.0 million), representing a 19.2% increase from the same period in 2025. Basic and diluted net income per American depositary share ("ADS") attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.28 (US$0.04), compared with near zero for the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.38 (US$0.06), compared with RMB0.08 for the same period of 2025. "In the third quarter, we achieved operating profitability for the ninth consecutive quarter, reflecting the continued strength of our business. The strong reception of our newly launched Confucius speech and translation models in the global open-source community further demonstrated our leadership in real-time speech AI," said Dr. Feng Zhou, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Youdao. "Looking ahead, we will continue advancing our AI-Native Strategy, leveraging Confucius LLM to develop compelling products, deepen user engagement, and drive sustainable growth. We remain confident in meeting our full-year financial objectives, with continued improvements in operating profit and cash flow," Dr. Zhou concluded. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Net Revenues Net revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million), representing a 12.3% decrease from RMB1.6 billion for the same period of 2025. Net revenues from learning services were RMB609.4 million (US$90.9 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 5.2% decrease from RMB643.1 million for the same period of 2025. Net revenues from smart devices were RMB145.2 million (US$21.7 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 40.9% decrease from RMB245.8 million for the same period of 2025, primarily due to a decline in demand for smart learning devices. Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB674.3 million (US$100.6 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an 8.8% decrease from RMB739.7 million for the same period of 2025. The year-over-year decrease reflects Youdao's disciplined, strategic approach to engagement acceptance, which places greater emphasis on higher ROI (return on investment) engagements. Youdao believes this strategy has enhanced the overall operational efficiency of its business. Gross Profit and Gross Margin Gross profit for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB622.7 million (US$92.9 million), representing a 9.5% decrease from RMB687.9 million for the same period of 2025. Gross margin was 43.6% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 42.2% for the same period of 2025. Gross margin for learning services was 59.7% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 58.5% for the same period of 2025. Gross margin for smart devices was 41.0% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 50.3% for the same period of 2025. The decrease was mainly attributable to increased bill-of-materials cost for smart devices. Gross margin for online marketing services was 29.6% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 25.4% for the same period of 2025. The improvement was mainly attributable to improved gross margin profile of performance-based advertisements through third parties' internet properties compared with the same period of last year. Operating Expenses Total operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB589.0 million (US$87.9 million), compared with RMB659.6 million for the same period of last year. Sales and marketing expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB422.2 million (US$63.0 million), representing a decrease of 13.4% from RMB487.7 million for the same period of 2025. This decrease was attributable to the reduced marketing expenditures in smart devices. Research and development expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB118.3 million (US$17.6 million), representing a decrease of 7.4% from RMB127.8 million for the same period of 2025. The decrease was primarily due to the decreased headcount for research and development employees, leading to payroll savings. General and administrative expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB48.5 million (US$7.2 million), representing an increase of 10.0% from RMB44.1 million for the same period of 2025. The increase was mainly attributable to an increase in expected credit losses on the Company's accounts receivables. Income from Operations As a result of the foregoing, income from operations for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB33.7 million (US$5.0 million), increasing by 19.2% from RMB28.3 million for the same period in 2025. The margin of income from operations was 2.4%, compared with 1.7% for the same period of last year. Net Income Attributable to Youdao's Ordinary Shareholders Net income attributable to Youdao's ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB33.4 million (US$5.0 million), compared with RMB0.1 million for the same period of last year. Non-GAAP net income attributable to Youdao's ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB45.9 million (US$6.8 million), increasing by nearly 4 times from RMB9.2 million for the same period of last year. Basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB0.28 (US$0.04), compared with near zero for the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.38 (US$0.06), compared with RMB0.08 for the same period of 2025. Other Information As of September 30, 2026, Youdao's cash, cash equivalents, current and non-current restricted cash, time deposits and short-term investments totaled RMB599.8 million (US$89.5 million), compared with RMB743.2 million as of December 31, 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, net cash used in operating activities was RMB89.0 million (US$13.3 million). Youdao's ability to continue as a going concern is dependent on management's ability to implement an effective business plan amid a changing regulatory environment, generate operating cash flows, and secure external financing for future development. As of September 30, 2026, Youdao has received various forms of financial support from NetEase Group, including, among others, RMB748.0 million in a short-term loan, and US$120.4 million in long-term loans maturing on March 31, 2030, drawn from a US$300.0 million revolving loan facility. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's contract liabilities, which mainly consisted of deferred revenues generated from Youdao's learning services, were RMB771.8 million (US$115.1 million), compared with RMB847.7 million as of December 31, 2025. Share Repurchase Program On November 17, 2022, the Company announced that its Board of Directors had authorized the Company to adopt a share repurchase program in accordance with applicable laws and regulations for up to US$20.0 million of its Class A ordinary shares (including in the form of ADSs) during a period of up to 36 months beginning on November 18, 2022. This amount was subsequently increased to US$40.0 million in August 2023. In November 2025 and August 2026, the Board approved amendments to this Program, each extending its expiration date by one year, ultimately to November 17, 2027. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had repurchased a total of approximately 7.5 million ADSs in the open market under the share repurchase program for a total consideration of approximately US$33.8 million. The presentation of non-GAAP financial measures is not intended to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the financial information prepared and presented in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America ("U.S. GAAP"). th.title: "สกลธี" เตือนแย่งน้ำดิบผลิตประปา จี้รัฐตั้งแม่งาน-ประกาศเขตอันตราย
th.description: วันนี้ (19 พ.ย.2569) นายสกลธี ภัททิยกุล สส.บัญชีรายชื่อ และรองหัวหน้าพรรคประชาธิปัตย์ ในฐานะ ประธาน กมธ.การสาธารณสุข สภาผู้แทนราษฎร เปิดเผยภายหลังการประชุมร่วมกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง เพื่อติดตามผลกระทบด้านสุขภาพของประชาชนจากกรณีสารเคมีและโลหะหนักปนเปื้อนในแม่น้ำสายและแม่น้ำสาขา จ.เชียงราย นายสกลธี ระบุว่า จากผลวิจัยและการตรวจสอบแหล่งน้ำ คาดการณ์ว่าสารปนเปื้อนดังกล่าวมีต้นตอมาจากประเทศเมียนมา ซึ่งกระทรวงการต่างประเทศได้ชี้แจงว่าเคยทำหนังสือประท้วงไปแล้วครั้งหนึ่งเมื่อปี 2568 และ ล่าสุด รมว.ต่างประเทศ รวมถึงกระทรวงทรัพยากรธรรมชาติและสิ่งแวดล้อมของทั้ง 2 ประเทศ ได้หารือเพื่อกำหนดมาตรฐานกลาง ในการตรวจคุณภาพน้ำร่วมกันอย่างเป็นทางการ โดยจะมีการเจรจากันอีกครั้งในวันที่ 24-26 พ.ย.นี้ ซึ่งทาง กมธ. ได้เสนอแนะว่า หากผลตรวจยืนยันชัดเจนว่าต้นตอมาจากเมียนมา กระทรวงการต่างประเทศควรดำเนินการประท้วงหรือใช้มาตรการกดดันอย่างเป็นทางการ นอกจากนี้ กระทรวงการต่างประเทศยังเปิดเผยว่า นายกรัฐมนตรีของจีนได้รับปากกับรัฐบาลไทยว่าจะเข้ามาช่วยดูแลปัญหานี้ด้วย เนื่องจากกังวลว่าสารพิษอาจไหลลงสู่แม่น้ำโขงและลุกลามเป็นวิกฤตระดับภูมิภาค ในด้านสถานการณ์น้ำและสุขภาพ กรมอนามัยยืนยันว่า น้ำประปาใน อ.แม่สาย ยังคงมีความปลอดภัย สามารถใช้อุปโภคบริโภคได้ตามปกติ แต่ กมธ. ไม่แนะนำให้ประชาชนใช้น้ำดิบจากแม่น้ำสายโดยตรง พร้อมเตือนถึงปัญหาการแย่งชิงน้ำดิบสำหรับผลิตน้ำประปาที่เริ่มเกิดขึ้นในพื้นที่ ซึ่งรัฐบาลต้องเร่งเข้ามาบริหารจัดการก่อนจะเกิดภาวะขาดแคลนในอนาคต ขณะที่ข้อมูลจากกรมควบคุมโรคในปี 2569 พบว่าจากการคัดกรองประชาชน 10,000 คน และคัดเลือกกลุ่มเสี่ยงมาตรวจร่างกายเบื้องต้น 1,200 คน พบผู้มีสารหนูตกค้างในร่างกายสูงถึง 94 คน หรือคิดเป็นร้อยละ 7 ของกลุ่มเสี่ยง กมธ.การสาธารณสุข จึงมีข้อเสนอเร่งด่วนไปยังรัฐบาล ให้จัดสรรงบประมาณสนับสนุนองค์กรปกครองส่วนท้องถิ่น สำหรับจัดซื้อชุดตรวจสารหนูเบื้องต้น ซึ่งมีราคาสูงถึงชุดละ 2,900 บาท เพื่อให้สามารถขยายผลการคัดกรองไปยังประชาชนกลุ่มอื่นที่ใช้น้ำเพื่อการอุปโภคบริโภคและการเกษตรได้อย่างทั่วถึง รวมถึงขอให้กระทรวงสาธารณสุขจัดทำแผนรับมือระยะ 5 ปี เนื่องจากสารหนูสามารถสะสมในร่างกายได้นานเกิน 5 ปี จำเป็นต้องมีระบบติดตามอาการผู้ที่พบสารเกินค่ามาตรฐานอย่างต่อเนื่อง และเตรียมความพร้อมของ รพ.แม่สาย ให้รองรับผู้ป่วยได้ทันท่วงที นอกจากนี้ นายสกลธี เตรียมทำหนังสือสอบถามไปยัง ผวจ.เชียงราย ถึงความคืบหน้าแผนการคัดกรองประชาชนทั้งจังหวัด รวมถึงการสุ่มตรวจสัตว์น้ำ พืชผลทางการเกษตร ตลอดจนโรงงานผลิตน้ำดื่มและน้ำแข็งกว่า 300 แห่งในพื้นที่ พร้อมเรียกร้องให้รัฐบาลพิจารณาประกาศพื้นที่เขตอันตรายเฝ้าระวัง และเร่งแต่งตั้ง "เจ้าภาพหรือแม่งานหลัก" เพื่อบูรณาการทำงานร่วมกันระหว่างกระทรวงสาธารณสุข กระทรวงทรัพยากรฯ กระทรวงเกษตรฯ กระทรวงมหาดไทย และกระทรวงการต่างประเทศ ที่ปัจจุบันยังขาดผู้รับผิดชอบหลักอย่างชัดเจน นายสกลธี ทิ้งท้ายว่า กมธ. จะทำหนังสือสอบถามไปยังหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องและเรียกประชุมติดตามความคืบหน้าอีกครั้ง ขณะเดียวกัน พรรคประชาธิปัตย์เตรียมเสนอญัตติด่วนต่อสภาผู้แทนราษฎร เพื่อขอตั้งคณะกรรมาธิการวิสามัญเข้ามาแก้ไขปัญหานี้อย่างเป็นระบบ เนื่องจากกระบวนการฟื้นฟูแหล่งน้ำให้ปลอดจากสารโลหะหนักต้องใช้เวลาอย่างน้อย 3-5 ปี รัฐบาลจึงจำเป็นต้องให้ความสำคัญและดำเนินการอย่างจริงจังมากกว่าที่เป็นอยู่ อ่านข่าว : ไฟไหม้ในห้องอาหารอาคารรัฐสภา คาดไฟฟ้าลัดวงจร "ไฮโซระย้า" หอบหลักฐานแจง ตร.ปอศ.ปมซื้อขายเครื่องเพชรกับ "บุ๋ม ปนัดดา" ไทยปิดดีล FTA เปรูฉบับสมบูรณ์ ปลดล็อกตลาดสินค้า–บริการ จ่อลุยลาตินอเมริกา

ph.title: Youdao, Inc. to Hold Annual General Meeting on December 17, 2026
ph.description: BEIJING, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Youdao, Inc. ("Youdao" or the "Company") (NYSE: DAO), an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising, today announced that it will hold its annual general meeting of shareholders (the "AGM") at its offices at Building No.7, West Zone, Zhongguancun Software Park (Phase II), No.10 Xibeiwang East Road, Haidian District, Beijing, People's Republic of China on December 17, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (Beijing Time). No proposal will be submitted for shareholder approval at the AGM. Instead, the AGM will serve as an open forum for shareholders and beneficial owners of the Company's American Depositary Shares ("ADSs") to discuss Company affairs with management. The Board of Directors of the Company has fixed the close of business on December 1, 2026 (Eastern Standard Time) as the record date (the "Record Date") for determining the shareholders entitled to receive notice of, and to attend, the AGM or any adjournment or postponement thereof. Holders of record of the Company's Class A ordinary shares and Class B ordinary shares at the close of business on the Record Date are entitled to attend the AGM and any adjournment or postponement thereof in person. Beneficial owners of the Company's ADSs are also welcome to attend the AGM in person. Shareholders and ADS holders may access the Company's annual report on the Company's investor relations website at http://ir.youdao.com as well as the SEC's website at http://www.sec.gov. The Company will provide a hard copy of its annual report containing the audited consolidated financial statements, free of charge, to its shareholders and ADS holders upon request. Requests should be directed to the Company by emailing Investor Relations at IR@rd.netease.com. About Youdao, Inc. Youdao, Inc. (NYSE: DAO) is strategically positioned as an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising. Youdao now mainly offers learning services, online marketing services and smart devices – all powered by advanced technologies. Youdao was founded in 2006 as part of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTES; HKEX: 9999), a leading internet technology company in China. For more information, please visit: http://ir.youdao.com. ph.title: Youdao Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
ph.description: HANGZHOU, China, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Youdao, Inc. ("Youdao" or the "Company") (NYSE: DAO), an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Total net revenues were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million), representing a 12.3% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from learning services were RMB609.4 million (US$90.9 million), representing a 5.2% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from smart devices were RMB145.2 million (US$21.7 million), representing a 40.9% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB674.3 million (US$100.6 million), representing an 8.8% decrease from the same period in 2025. Gross margin was 43.6%, compared with 42.2% for the same period in 2025. Income from operations was RMB33.7 million (US$5.0 million), representing a 19.2% increase from the same period in 2025. Basic and diluted net income per American depositary share ("ADS") attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.28 (US$0.04), compared with near zero for the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.38 (US$0.06), compared with RMB0.08 for the same period of 2025. "In the third quarter, we achieved operating profitability for the ninth consecutive quarter, reflecting the continued strength of our business. The strong reception of our newly launched Confucius speech and translation models in the global open-source community further demonstrated our leadership in real-time speech AI," said Dr. Feng Zhou, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Youdao. "Looking ahead, we will continue advancing our AI-Native Strategy, leveraging Confucius LLM to develop compelling products, deepen user engagement, and drive sustainable growth. We remain confident in meeting our full-year financial objectives, with continued improvements in operating profit and cash flow," Dr. Zhou concluded. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Net Revenues Net revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million), representing a 12.3% decrease from RMB1.6 billion for the same period of 2025. Net revenues from learning services were RMB609.4 million (US$90.9 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 5.2% decrease from RMB643.1 million for the same period of 2025. Net revenues from smart devices were RMB145.2 million (US$21.7 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 40.9% decrease from RMB245.8 million for the same period of 2025, primarily due to a decline in demand for smart learning devices. Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB674.3 million (US$100.6 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an 8.8% decrease from RMB739.7 million for the same period of 2025. The year-over-year decrease reflects Youdao's disciplined, strategic approach to engagement acceptance, which places greater emphasis on higher ROI (return on investment) engagements. Youdao believes this strategy has enhanced the overall operational efficiency of its business. Gross Profit and Gross Margin Gross profit for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB622.7 million (US$92.9 million), representing a 9.5% decrease from RMB687.9 million for the same period of 2025. Gross margin was 43.6% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 42.2% for the same period of 2025. Gross margin for learning services was 59.7% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 58.5% for the same period of 2025. Gross margin for smart devices was 41.0% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 50.3% for the same period of 2025. The decrease was mainly attributable to increased bill-of-materials cost for smart devices. Gross margin for online marketing services was 29.6% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 25.4% for the same period of 2025. The improvement was mainly attributable to improved gross margin profile of performance-based advertisements through third parties' internet properties compared with the same period of last year. Operating Expenses Total operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB589.0 million (US$87.9 million), compared with RMB659.6 million for the same period of last year. Sales and marketing expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB422.2 million (US$63.0 million), representing a decrease of 13.4% from RMB487.7 million for the same period of 2025. This decrease was attributable to the reduced marketing expenditures in smart devices. Research and development expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB118.3 million (US$17.6 million), representing a decrease of 7.4% from RMB127.8 million for the same period of 2025. The decrease was primarily due to the decreased headcount for research and development employees, leading to payroll savings. General and administrative expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB48.5 million (US$7.2 million), representing an increase of 10.0% from RMB44.1 million for the same period of 2025. The increase was mainly attributable to an increase in expected credit losses on the Company's accounts receivables. Income from Operations As a result of the foregoing, income from operations for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB33.7 million (US$5.0 million), increasing by 19.2% from RMB28.3 million for the same period in 2025. The margin of income from operations was 2.4%, compared with 1.7% for the same period of last year. Net Income Attributable to Youdao's Ordinary Shareholders Net income attributable to Youdao's ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB33.4 million (US$5.0 million), compared with RMB0.1 million for the same period of last year. Non-GAAP net income attributable to Youdao's ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB45.9 million (US$6.8 million), increasing by nearly 4 times from RMB9.2 million for the same period of last year. Basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB0.28 (US$0.04), compared with near zero for the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.38 (US$0.06), compared with RMB0.08 for the same period of 2025. Other Information As of September 30, 2026, Youdao's cash, cash equivalents, current and non-current restricted cash, time deposits and short-term investments totaled RMB599.8 million (US$89.5 million), compared with RMB743.2 million as of December 31, 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, net cash used in operating activities was RMB89.0 million (US$13.3 million). Youdao's ability to continue as a going concern is dependent on management's ability to implement an effective business plan amid a changing regulatory environment, generate operating cash flows, and secure external financing for future development. As of September 30, 2026, Youdao has received various forms of financial support from NetEase Group, including, among others, RMB748.0 million in a short-term loan, and US$120.4 million in long-term loans maturing on March 31, 2030, drawn from a US$300.0 million revolving loan facility. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's contract liabilities, which mainly consisted of deferred revenues generated from Youdao's learning services, were RMB771.8 million (US$115.1 million), compared with RMB847.7 million as of December 31, 2025. Share Repurchase Program On November 17, 2022, the Company announced that its Board of Directors had authorized the Company to adopt a share repurchase program in accordance with applicable laws and regulations for up to US$20.0 million of its Class A ordinary shares (including in the form of ADSs) during a period of up to 36 months beginning on November 18, 2022. This amount was subsequently increased to US$40.0 million in August 2023. In November 2025 and August 2026, the Board approved amendments to this Program, each extending its expiration date by one year, ultimately to November 17, 2027. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had repurchased a total of approximately 7.5 million ADSs in the open market under the share repurchase program for a total consideration of approximately US$33.8 million. Conference Call Youdao's management team will host a teleconference call with simultaneous webcast at 5:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, November 19, 2026 (Beijing/Hong Kong Time: 6:00 p.m., Thursday, November 19, 2026). Youdao's management will be on the call to discuss the financial results and answer questions. A replay of the conference call will be accessible by phone one hour after the conclusion of the live call at the following numbers, until November 26, 2026: United States: +1-855-669-9658 +1-412-317-0088 Replay Access Code: About Youdao, Inc. Youdao mainly offers learning services, online marketing services and smart devices – all powered by advanced technologies. Youdao was founded in 2006 as part of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTES; HKEX: 9999), a leading internet technology company in China. For more information, please visit: http://ir.youdao.com. Non-GAAP Measures Youdao considers and uses non-GAAP financial measures, such as non-GAAP net income attributable to the Company's ordinary shareholders and non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS, as supplemental metrics in reviewing and assessing its operating performance and formulating its business plan. The presentation of non-GAAP financial measures is not intended to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the financial information prepared and presented in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America ("U.S. GAAP"). Youdao defines non-GAAP net income attributable to the Company's ordinary shareholders as net income attributable to the Company's ordinary shareholders excluding share-based compensation expenses, impairment of long-term investments, gain from fair value change of long-term investment and adjustment for GAAP to non-GAAP reconciling item for the (income)/loss attributable to noncontrolling interests. Non-GAAP net income attributable to the Company's ordinary shareholders enables Youdao's management to assess its operating results without considering the impact of these items, which are non-cash charges in nature. Youdao believes that these non-GAAP financial measures provide useful information to investors in understanding and evaluating the Company's current operating performance and prospects in the same manner as management does, if they so choose. Non-GAAP financial measures are not defined under U.S. GAAP and are not presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP. Non-GAAP financial measures have limitations as analytical tools, which possibly do not reflect all items of expense that affect our operations. In addition, the non-GAAP financial measures Youdao uses may differ from the non-GAAP measures uses by other companies, including peer companies, and therefore their comparability may be limited. For more information on these non-GAAP financial measures, please see the table captioned "Unaudited Reconciliation of GAAP and Non-GAAP Results" set forth at the end of this release. The accompanying table has more details on the reconciliation between our GAAP financial measures that are mostly directly comparable to non-GAAP financial measures. Youdao encourages you to review its financial information in its entirety and not rely on a single financial measure. Unless otherwise stated, all translations from RMB to US$ were made at the rate of RMB6.7045 to US$1.00, the exchange rate on September 30, 2026 set forth in the H.10 statistical release of the Federal Reserve Board. The Company makes no representation that the RMB or US$ amounts referred could be converted into US$ or RMB, as the case may be, at any particular rate or at all. ph.title: Humyn Labs Raises USD 47M in Series A to Scale Physical AI Research and Deployment
ph.description: SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Humyn Labs, a Physical AI research and deployment company, today announced USD 47 million in Series A funding to accelerate robot deployment-readiness across real-world environments in Brazil, South Korea, and India. Co-Founder Ishank Gupta (L) Co-Founder Manish Agarwal (R) Humyn labs The USD 26 million equity round was led by Accel, with participation from Prosus Ventures, BeeGlobal, Finserv Intelligence through Bajaj Finance, Bajaj Alts AI Opportunities Fund, Dallas Venture Capital, Lighthouse Canton, Jump Trading LLC, and marquee angel investor Anita Pramoda, former CFO of Epic. The USD 21 million venture debt round was led by Lighthouse Canton, with participation from Trifecta Capital. Humyn Labs has surpassed USD 50 million in annualised revenue within six months of operations. Working with frontier AI labs, robotics companies, and world-model developers, it runs capture and enrichment operations across 20+ countries in Latin America, East Asia, and South and Southeast Asia. The funding will support deployment-readiness infrastructure in Brazil, South Korea, and India; capture hardware and enrichment engines; and on-the-ground presence in San Francisco, London, and Seoul. Founded in 2026 by Manish Agarwal (IIM Ahmedabad) and Ishank Gupta (The Wharton School), Humyn Labs turns human experience into physical understanding for robots by capturing real-world work across factories, warehouses, farms, and homes. Its proprietary capture devices record specific jobs to lab requirements, while its data engine converts recordings into labelled, training-ready datasets with verified provenance across sight, sound, motion, and touch. Manish Agarwal, Co-founder, Humyn Labs, said, "Physical AI will only be as good as the real-world data it learns from. This funding will help us strengthen our research, build trust with labs and enterprises, and expand globally. With a USD 10 billion opportunity in data infrastructure, we aim to build a USD 1 billion annual revenue business." Ishank Gupta, Co-founder, Humyn Labs, said, "A robot does not learn a job from the internet; it learns from the person who has done it for twenty years on the floor. We bring the model lab and site operator onto that floor together so every deployment teaches the next model." Pratik Agarwal, Partner, Accel, said, "Physical AI is a defining technology shift of the next decade, and data and deployment are where the real moat will be built. Humyn Labs has the technical depth and customer pull to be a category leader." Explore careers at humynlabs.ai/careers. Contact: Sharmilee Daru SD@4WDtechPR.com

ph.title: Hisense Makes Everyday Laundry Simpler with Smarter Care
ph.description: QINGDAO, China, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hisense, a leading brand in global consumer electronics and home appliances, believes technology should fit naturally into everyday life. Its 5i heat pump washer dryer brings this philosophy to the laundry room, combining a standard-size footprint with a larger drum for greater capacity, while fitting seamlessly into existing cabinetry and taking more of the guesswork out of everyday laundry. Hisense 5i Heat Pump Washer Dryer For many people, laundry comes with familiar moments of uncertainty: Will a favorite cashmere jumper lose its shape? Is this fabric safe to tumble dry? Which cycle is right for a mixed load? And where is there room to dry everything? The 5i is designed around these concerns, bringing Gentle Care, Fit&Max capacity, four A-class ratings under the EU energy label, and AI Super Wash & Dry together in one appliance. Its heat-pump drying system maintains a precise 40°C Gentle Dry temperature, significantly lower than conventional condenser models, providing gentler care for fabrics while recycling heat for greater efficiency. With a 12kg wash capacity and 8kg drying capacity, the large drum handles bigger loads while the standard-size design fits naturally into the home. The 5i brings intelligence through AI Super Wash & Dry. Its 13 sensors monitor factors including load weight, water hardness and temperature, automatically adjusting the cycle to suit each load. Its 4A energy efficiency can also help reduce the energy cost of everyday laundry. This thinking extends to Hisense's AI Companion Laundry Suite, introduced at IFA 2026. By recognizing clothing characteristics, the suite automatically selects suitable wash and dry cycles and adjusts the process, accordingly, creating a more seamless load-and-go experience. For Hisense, intelligent technology should work quietly in the background, making everyday routines simpler and giving people more time for the moments that make life brighter. About Hisense Hisense, founded in 1969, is a globally recognized leader in home appliances and consumer electronics with operations in over 180 countries, specializing in delivering high-quality multimedia products, home appliances, and intelligent IT solutions. According to Omdia, Hisense ranks No. 1 globally in the 100-inch and over TV segment (2023-2026H1). As The Origin of RGB MiniLED, Hisense continues to lead the next-generation RGB MiniLED innovation. As an Official Partner of UEFA EURO 2028, Hisense continues its legacy of global sports partnerships, bringing people closer to the moments that unite fans around the world.

ph.title: South Korea tightens security for national exam over AI cheating scandal
ph.description: More than 550,000 candidates sat South Korea’s Suneung university entrance exam under extraordinary security, after an AI cheating scandal in which a top scorer on a national tax accountant exam admitted using a hidden mini camera to send questions to an AI system. Authorities inspected students’ glasses, deployed thousands of extra supervisors and ordered stickers over every button on candidates’ clothing. A nationwide disaster alert was also sent to make even muted phones buzz, exposing any devices smuggled into exam rooms.

bd.title: Youdao, Inc. to Hold Annual General Meeting on December 17, 2026
bd.description: BEIJING, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Youdao, Inc. ("Youdao" or the "Company") (NYSE: DAO), an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising, today announced that it will hold its annual general meeting of shareholders (the "AGM") at its offices at Building No.7, West Zone, Zhongguancun Software Park (Phase II), No.10 Xibeiwang East Road, Haidian District, Beijing, People's Republic of China on December 17, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (Beijing Time). No proposal will be submitted for shareholder approval at the AGM. Instead, the AGM will serve as an open forum for shareholders and beneficial owners of the Company's American Depositary Shares ("ADSs") to discuss Company affairs with management. The Board of Directors of the Company has fixed the close of business on December 1, 2026 (Eastern Standard Time) as the record date (the "Record Date") for determining the shareholders entitled to receive notice of, and to attend, the AGM or any adjournment or postponement thereof. Holders of record of the Company's Class A ordinary shares and Class B ordinary shares at the close of business on the Record Date are entitled to attend the AGM and any adjournment or postponement thereof in person. Beneficial owners of the Company's ADSs are also welcome to attend the AGM in person. Shareholders and ADS holders may access the Company's annual report on the Company's investor relations website at http://ir.youdao.com as well as the SEC's website at http://www.sec.gov. The Company will provide a hard copy of its annual report containing the audited consolidated financial statements, free of charge, to its shareholders and ADS holders upon request. Requests should be directed to the Company by emailing Investor Relations at IR@rd.netease.com. About Youdao, Inc. Youdao, Inc. (NYSE: DAO) is strategically positioned as an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising. (NASDAQ: NTES; HKEX: 9999), a leading internet technology company in China. For more information, please visit: http://ir.youdao.com. bd.title: Youdao Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
bd.description: HANGZHOU, China, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Youdao, Inc. ("Youdao" or the "Company") (NYSE: DAO), an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Total net revenues were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million), representing a 12.3% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from learning services were RMB609.4 million (US$90.9 million), representing a 5.2% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from smart devices were RMB145.2 million (US$21.7 million), representing a 40.9% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB674.3 million (US$100.6 million), representing an 8.8% decrease from the same period in 2025. Gross margin was 43.6%, compared with 42.2% for the same period in 2025. Income from operations was RMB33.7 million (US$5.0 million), representing a 19.2% increase from the same period in 2025. Basic and diluted net income per American depositary share ("ADS") attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.28 (US$0.04), compared with near zero for the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.38 (US$0.06), compared with RMB0.08 for the same period of 2025. "In the third quarter, we achieved operating profitability for the ninth consecutive quarter, reflecting the continued strength of our business. The strong reception of our newly launched Confucius speech and translation models in the global open-source community further demonstrated our leadership in real-time speech AI," said Dr. Feng Zhou, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Youdao. "Looking ahead, we will continue advancing our AI-Native Strategy, leveraging Confucius LLM to develop compelling products, deepen user engagement, and drive sustainable growth. We remain confident in meeting our full-year financial objectives, with continued improvements in operating profit and cash flow," Dr. Zhou concluded. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Net Revenues Net revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million), representing a 12.3% decrease from RMB1.6 billion for the same period of 2025. Net revenues from learning services were RMB609.4 million (US$90.9 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 5.2% decrease from RMB643.1 million for the same period of 2025. Net revenues from smart devices were RMB145.2 million (US$21.7 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 40.9% decrease from RMB245.8 million for the same period of 2025, primarily due to a decline in demand for smart learning devices. Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB674.3 million (US$100.6 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an 8.8% decrease from RMB739.7 million for the same period of 2025. The year-over-year decrease reflects Youdao's disciplined, strategic approach to engagement acceptance, which places greater emphasis on higher ROI (return on investment) engagements. Youdao believes this strategy has enhanced the overall operational efficiency of its business. Gross Profit and Gross Margin Gross profit for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB622.7 million (US$92.9 million), representing a 9.5% decrease from RMB687.9 million for the same period of 2025. Gross margin was 43.6% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 42.2% for the same period of 2025. Gross margin for learning services was 59.7% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 58.5% for the same period of 2025. Gross margin for smart devices was 41.0% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 50.3% for the same period of 2025. The decrease was mainly attributable to increased bill-of-materials cost for smart devices. Gross margin for online marketing services was 29.6% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 25.4% for the same period of 2025. The improvement was mainly attributable to improved gross margin profile of performance-based advertisements through third parties' internet properties compared with the same period of last year. Operating Expenses Total operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB589.0 million (US$87.9 million), compared with RMB659.6 million for the same period of last year. Sales and marketing expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB422.2 million (US$63.0 million), representing a decrease of 13.4% from RMB487.7 million for the same period of 2025. This decrease was attributable to the reduced marketing expenditures in smart devices. Research and development expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB118.3 million (US$17.6 million), representing a decrease of 7.4% from RMB127.8 million for the same period of 2025. The decrease was primarily due to the decreased headcount for research and development employees, leading to payroll savings. General and administrative expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB48.5 million (US$7.2 million), representing an increase of 10.0% from RMB44.1 million for the same period of 2025. The increase was mainly attributable to an increase in expected credit losses on the Company's accounts receivables. Income from Operations As a result of the foregoing, income from operations for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB33.7 million (US$5.0 million), increasing by 19.2% from RMB28.3 million for the same period in 2025. The margin of income from operations was 2.4%, compared with 1.7% for the same period of last year. Net Income Attributable to Youdao's Ordinary Shareholders Net income attributable to Youdao's ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB33.4 million (US$5.0 million), compared with RMB0.1 million for the same period of last year. Non-GAAP net income attributable to Youdao's ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB45.9 million (US$6.8 million), increasing by nearly 4 times from RMB9.2 million for the same period of last year. Basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB0.28 (US$0.04), compared with near zero for the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.38 (US$0.06), compared with RMB0.08 for the same period of 2025. Other Information As of September 30, 2026, Youdao's cash, cash equivalents, current and non-current restricted cash, time deposits and short-term investments totaled RMB599.8 million (US$89.5 million), compared with RMB743.2 million as of December 31, 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, net cash used in operating activities was RMB89.0 million (US$13.3 million). Youdao's ability to continue as a going concern is dependent on management's ability to implement an effective business plan amid a changing regulatory environment, generate operating cash flows, and secure external financing for future development. As of September 30, 2026, Youdao has received various forms of financial support from NetEase Group, including, among others, RMB748.0 million in a short-term loan, and US$120.4 million in long-term loans maturing on March 31, 2030, drawn from a US$300.0 million revolving loan facility. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's contract liabilities, which mainly consisted of deferred revenues generated from Youdao's learning services, were RMB771.8 million (US$115.1 million), compared with RMB847.7 million as of December 31, 2025. Share Repurchase Program On November 17, 2022, the Company announced that its Board of Directors had authorized the Company to adopt a share repurchase program in accordance with applicable laws and regulations for up to US$20.0 million of its Class A ordinary shares (including in the form of ADSs) during a period of up to 36 months beginning on November 18, 2022. This amount was subsequently increased to US$40.0 million in August 2023. In November 2025 and August 2026, the Board approved amendments to this Program, each extending its expiration date by one year, ultimately to November 17, 2027. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had repurchased a total of approximately 7.5 million ADSs in the open market under the share repurchase program for a total consideration of approximately US$33.8 million. The presentation of non-GAAP financial measures is not intended to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the financial information prepared and presented in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America ("U.S. GAAP"). Youdao defines non-GAAP net income attributable to the Company's ordinary shareholders as net income attributable to the Company's ordinary shareholders excluding share-based compensation expenses, impairment of long-term investments, gain from fair value change of long-term investment and adjustment for GAAP to non-GAAP reconciling item for the (income)/loss attributable to noncontrolling interests. bd.title: Humyn Labs Raises USD 47M in Series A to Scale Physical AI Research and Deployment
bd.description: SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Humyn Labs, a Physical AI research and deployment company, today announced USD 47 million in Series A funding to accelerate robot deployment-readiness across real-world environments in Brazil, South Korea, and India. Co-Founder Ishank Gupta (L) Co-Founder Manish Agarwal (R) Humyn labs The USD 26 million equity round was led by Accel, with participation from Prosus Ventures, BeeGlobal, Finserv Intelligence through Bajaj Finance, Bajaj Alts AI Opportunities Fund, Dallas Venture Capital, Lighthouse Canton, Jump Trading LLC, and marquee angel investor Anita Pramoda, former CFO of Epic. The USD 21 million venture debt round was led by Lighthouse Canton, with participation from Trifecta Capital. Humyn Labs has surpassed USD 50 million in annualised revenue within six months of operations. Working with frontier AI labs, robotics companies, and world-model developers, it runs capture and enrichment operations across 20+ countries in Latin America, East Asia, and South and Southeast Asia. The funding will support deployment-readiness infrastructure in Brazil, South Korea, and India; capture hardware and enrichment engines; and on-the-ground presence in San Francisco, London, and Seoul. Founded in 2026 by Manish Agarwal (IIM Ahmedabad) and Ishank Gupta (The Wharton School), Humyn Labs turns human experience into physical understanding for robots by capturing real-world work across factories, warehouses, farms, and homes. Its proprietary capture devices record specific jobs to lab requirements, while its data engine converts recordings into labelled, training-ready datasets with verified provenance across sight, sound, motion, and touch. Manish Agarwal, Co-founder, Humyn Labs, said, "Physical AI will only be as good as the real-world data it learns from. This funding will help us strengthen our research, build trust with labs and enterprises, and expand globally. With a USD 10 billion opportunity in data infrastructure, we aim to build a USD 1 billion annual revenue business." Ishank Gupta, Co-founder, Humyn Labs, said, "A robot does not learn a job from the internet; it learns from the person who has done it for twenty years on the floor. We bring the model lab and site operator onto that floor together so every deployment teaches the next model." Pratik Agarwal, Partner, Accel, said, "Physical AI is a defining technology shift of the next decade, and data and deployment are where the real moat will be built. Humyn Labs has the technical depth and customer pull to be a category leader." Explore careers at humynlabs.ai/careers. Contact: Sharmilee Daru SD@4WDtechPR.com

bd.title: Hisense Makes Everyday Laundry Simpler with Smarter Care
bd.description: QINGDAO, China, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hisense, a leading brand in global consumer electronics and home appliances, believes technology should fit naturally into everyday life. Its 5i heat pump washer dryer brings this philosophy to the laundry room, combining a standard-size footprint with a larger drum for greater capacity, while fitting seamlessly into existing cabinetry and taking more of the guesswork out of everyday laundry. Hisense 5i Heat Pump Washer Dryer For many people, laundry comes with familiar moments of uncertainty: Will a favorite cashmere jumper lose its shape? Is this fabric safe to tumble dry? Which cycle is right for a mixed load? And where is there room to dry everything? The 5i is designed around these concerns, bringing Gentle Care, Fit&Max capacity, four A-class ratings under the EU energy label, and AI Super Wash & Dry together in one appliance. Its heat-pump drying system maintains a precise 40°C Gentle Dry temperature, significantly lower than conventional condenser models, providing gentler care for fabrics while recycling heat for greater efficiency. With a 12kg wash capacity and 8kg drying capacity, the large drum handles bigger loads while the standard-size design fits naturally into the home. The 5i brings intelligence through AI Super Wash & Dry. Its 13 sensors monitor factors including load weight, water hardness and temperature, automatically adjusting the cycle to suit each load. Its 4A energy efficiency can also help reduce the energy cost of everyday laundry. This thinking extends to Hisense's AI Companion Laundry Suite, introduced at IFA 2026. By recognizing clothing characteristics, the suite automatically selects suitable wash and dry cycles and adjusts the process, accordingly, creating a more seamless load-and-go experience. For Hisense, intelligent technology should work quietly in the background, making everyday routines simpler and giving people more time for the moments that make life brighter. About Hisense Hisense, founded in 1969, is a globally recognized leader in home appliances and consumer electronics with operations in over 180 countries, specializing in delivering high-quality multimedia products, home appliances, and intelligent IT solutions. According to Omdia, Hisense ranks No. 1 globally in the 100-inch and over TV segment (2023-2026H1). As The Origin of RGB MiniLED, Hisense continues to lead the next-generation RGB MiniLED innovation. As an Official Partner of UEFA EURO 2028, Hisense continues its legacy of global sports partnerships, bringing people closer to the moments that unite fans around the world.

bd.title: South Korea tightens security for national exam over AI cheating scandal
bd.description: More than 550,000 candidates sat South Korea’s Suneung university entrance exam under extraordinary security, after an AI cheating scandal in which a top scorer on a national tax accountant exam admitted using a hidden mini camera to send questions to an AI system. Authorities inspected students’ glasses, deployed thousands of extra supervisors and ordered stickers over every button on candidates’ clothing. A nationwide disaster alert was also sent to make even muted phones buzz, exposing any devices smuggled into exam rooms.

pk.title: Youdao, Inc. to Hold Annual General Meeting on December 17, 2026
pk.description: BEIJING, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Youdao, Inc. ("Youdao" or the "Company") (NYSE: DAO), an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising, today announced that it will hold its annual general meeting of shareholders (the "AGM") at its offices at Building No.7, West Zone, Zhongguancun Software Park (Phase II), No.10 Xibeiwang East Road, Haidian District, Beijing, People's Republic of China on December 17, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (Beijing Time). No proposal will be submitted for shareholder approval at the AGM. Instead, the AGM will serve as an open forum for shareholders and beneficial owners of the Company's American Depositary Shares ("ADSs") to discuss Company affairs with management. The Board of Directors of the Company has fixed the close of business on December 1, 2026 (Eastern Standard Time) as the record date (the "Record Date") for determining the shareholders entitled to receive notice of, and to attend, the AGM or any adjournment or postponement thereof. Holders of record of the Company's Class A ordinary shares and Class B ordinary shares at the close of business on the Record Date are entitled to attend the AGM and any adjournment or postponement thereof in person. Beneficial owners of the Company's ADSs are also welcome to attend the AGM in person. Shareholders and ADS holders may access the Company's annual report on the Company's investor relations website at http://ir.youdao.com as well as the SEC's website at http://www.sec.gov. The Company will provide a hard copy of its annual report containing the audited consolidated financial statements, free of charge, to its shareholders and ADS holders upon request. Requests should be directed to the Company by emailing Investor Relations at IR@rd.netease.com. About Youdao, Inc. Youdao, Inc. (NYSE: DAO) is strategically positioned as an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising. Youdao now mainly offers learning services, online marketing services and smart devices – all powered by advanced technologies. Youdao was founded in 2006 as part of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTES; HKEX: 9999), a leading internet technology company in China. For more information, please visit: http://ir.youdao.com. pk.title: Youdao Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
pk.description: HANGZHOU, China, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Youdao, Inc. ("Youdao" or the "Company") (NYSE: DAO), an AI solutions provider specializing in learning and advertising, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Total net revenues were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million), representing a 12.3% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from learning services were RMB609.4 million (US$90.9 million), representing a 5.2% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from smart devices were RMB145.2 million (US$21.7 million), representing a 40.9% decrease from the same period in 2025. - Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB674.3 million (US$100.6 million), representing an 8.8% decrease from the same period in 2025. Gross margin was 43.6%, compared with 42.2% for the same period in 2025. Income from operations was RMB33.7 million (US$5.0 million), representing a 19.2% increase from the same period in 2025. Basic and diluted net income per American depositary share ("ADS") attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.28 (US$0.04), compared with near zero for the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.38 (US$0.06), compared with RMB0.08 for the same period of 2025. "In the third quarter, we achieved operating profitability for the ninth consecutive quarter, reflecting the continued strength of our business. The strong reception of our newly launched Confucius speech and translation models in the global open-source community further demonstrated our leadership in real-time speech AI," said Dr. Feng Zhou, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Youdao. "Looking ahead, we will continue advancing our AI-Native Strategy, leveraging Confucius LLM to develop compelling products, deepen user engagement, and drive sustainable growth. We remain confident in meeting our full-year financial objectives, with continued improvements in operating profit and cash flow," Dr. Zhou concluded. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Net Revenues Net revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB1.4 billion (US$213.1 million), representing a 12.3% decrease from RMB1.6 billion for the same period of 2025. Net revenues from learning services were RMB609.4 million (US$90.9 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 5.2% decrease from RMB643.1 million for the same period of 2025. Net revenues from smart devices were RMB145.2 million (US$21.7 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 40.9% decrease from RMB245.8 million for the same period of 2025, primarily due to a decline in demand for smart learning devices. Net revenues from online marketing services were RMB674.3 million (US$100.6 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing an 8.8% decrease from RMB739.7 million for the same period of 2025. The year-over-year decrease reflects Youdao's disciplined, strategic approach to engagement acceptance, which places greater emphasis on higher ROI (return on investment) engagements. Youdao believes this strategy has enhanced the overall operational efficiency of its business. Gross Profit and Gross Margin Gross profit for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB622.7 million (US$92.9 million), representing a 9.5% decrease from RMB687.9 million for the same period of 2025. Gross margin was 43.6% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 42.2% for the same period of 2025. Gross margin for learning services was 59.7% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 58.5% for the same period of 2025. Gross margin for smart devices was 41.0% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 50.3% for the same period of 2025. The decrease was mainly attributable to increased bill-of-materials cost for smart devices. Gross margin for online marketing services was 29.6% for the third quarter of 2026, compared with 25.4% for the same period of 2025. The improvement was mainly attributable to improved gross margin profile of performance-based advertisements through third parties' internet properties compared with the same period of last year. Operating Expenses Total operating expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB589.0 million (US$87.9 million), compared with RMB659.6 million for the same period of last year. Sales and marketing expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB422.2 million (US$63.0 million), representing a decrease of 13.4% from RMB487.7 million for the same period of 2025. This decrease was attributable to the reduced marketing expenditures in smart devices. Research and development expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB118.3 million (US$17.6 million), representing a decrease of 7.4% from RMB127.8 million for the same period of 2025. The decrease was primarily due to the decreased headcount for research and development employees, leading to payroll savings. General and administrative expenses for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB48.5 million (US$7.2 million), representing an increase of 10.0% from RMB44.1 million for the same period of 2025. The increase was mainly attributable to an increase in expected credit losses on the Company's accounts receivables. Income from Operations As a result of the foregoing, income from operations for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB33.7 million (US$5.0 million), increasing by 19.2% from RMB28.3 million for the same period in 2025. The margin of income from operations was 2.4%, compared with 1.7% for the same period of last year. Net Income Attributable to Youdao's Ordinary Shareholders Net income attributable to Youdao's ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB33.4 million (US$5.0 million), compared with RMB0.1 million for the same period of last year. Non-GAAP net income attributable to Youdao's ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 was RMB45.9 million (US$6.8 million), increasing by nearly 4 times from RMB9.2 million for the same period of last year. Basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders for the third quarter of 2026 were RMB0.28 (US$0.04), compared with near zero for the same period of 2025. Non-GAAP basic and diluted net income per ADS attributable to ordinary shareholders were RMB0.38 (US$0.06), compared with RMB0.08 for the same period of 2025. Other Information As of September 30, 2026, Youdao's cash, cash equivalents, current and non-current restricted cash, time deposits and short-term investments totaled RMB599.8 million (US$89.5 million), compared with RMB743.2 million as of December 31, 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, net cash used in operating activities was RMB89.0 million (US$13.3 million). Youdao's ability to continue as a going concern is dependent on management's ability to implement an effective business plan amid a changing regulatory environment, generate operating cash flows, and secure external financing for future development. As of September 30, 2026, Youdao has received various forms of financial support from NetEase Group, including, among others, RMB748.0 million in a short-term loan, and US$120.4 million in long-term loans maturing on March 31, 2030, drawn from a US$300.0 million revolving loan facility. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's contract liabilities, which mainly consisted of deferred revenues generated from Youdao's learning services, were RMB771.8 million (US$115.1 million), compared with RMB847.7 million as of December 31, 2025. Share Repurchase Program On November 17, 2022, the Company announced that its Board of Directors had authorized the Company to adopt a share repurchase program in accordance with applicable laws and regulations for up to US$20.0 million of its Class A ordinary shares (including in the form of ADSs) during a period of up to 36 months beginning on November 18, 2022. This amount was subsequently increased to US$40.0 million in August 2023. In November 2025 and August 2026, the Board approved amendments to this Program, each extending its expiration date by one year, ultimately to November 17, 2027. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had repurchased a total of approximately 7.5 million ADSs in the open market under the share repurchase program for a total consideration of approximately US$33.8 million.
